newsitem.title: USA: Evans sees Q1 loss of $0.28/shr. [CORRECTED 19:22 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Evans sees Q1 loss of $0.28/shr. [CORRECTED 19:22 GMT]

text.p: Evans Systems Inc said Friday it expected a loss for the first quarter ended December 31 of $835,000, or $0.28 a share, on revenues of $37.8 million.
This compares to earnings of $38,000, or $0.01 a share, on revenues of $39.1 million a year earlier, the company said.

Evans estimated its first quarter operating loss at $562,000, or $0.18 a share. It cited a drop in operating revenues in its ChemWay segment as a result of the ChemWay production line being out of service in late November and December.

Evans said ChemWay closed down its aerosol production line in late November in order to make improvements and production enhancements. The line was completely refurbished and returned to production in late January.

The company also said it is taking a one-time non-cash charge to earnings of about $337,000 to reflect the re-classification of securities available for sale -- a bond fund the company has held since 1993 -- to trading securities.
Evans said the loss on these securities was previously recorded as an unrealized loss in the equity section of the balance sheet.
Evans also said it had decided to liquidate its trading portfolio, creating losses totaling $111,000 in this quarter.
Together, these two charges total $448,000, or $0.10 a share, it said. (Corrects by inserting information omitted from original story).
The company said it expects earnings and revenues for fiscal 1997 to substantially exceed fiscal 1996 results.
